title: Prosocial Behavior Detection in Player Game Chat: From Aligning Human-AI Definitions to Efficient Annotation at Scale

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM annotation performance using value-laden, task-specific label terms (e.g., 'PROSOCIAL') versus neutral, generic label placeholders (e.g., 'LABEL-1' or 'LABEL-2') to detect and measure unintended semantic anchoring effects on the model's predictions.

Evaluating prompt configurations with different gaming-domain personas (e.g., 'Moderator', 'COD Veteran', 'Community Manager') against a baseline with no persona to identify unintended performance degradation and biases introduced by enforcement-focused schemas.
